title: Далеко от завершения — не значит ничего не сделано
description: Далеко от завершения — не значит ничего не сделано: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Не подменять ограниченную отрицательную оценку крайним выводом
notes: Far from being complete означает значительную незавершённость.
Far from perfect не равно entirely useless: степень несовершенства и полная бесполезность — разные оценки.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.explanation: После from как предлога здесь нужна форма being.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: solving / solve.

public_payload.passage: The curator called the online catalogue “far from complete”. Several collections had not yet been described, and some existing records needed checking. A report of the discussion paraphrased this as “The catalogue has no value”. The curator rejected that conclusion. Visitors could already use thousands of reliable entries, even though coverage remained uneven. The point of the criticism was to identify unfinished work, not to deny every benefit of the work completed. The revised report stated both facts: the catalogue was useful in its current scope and still required substantial expansion and verification. A negative evaluation of completeness did not establish total uselessness.

options.label: Substantial work remained, though existing entries could be useful.

exercises.editorial_answer: Substantial work remained, though existing entries could be useful.
exercises.explanation: Критика полноты не равна отрицанию пользы всех готовых записей.
